parsed.review_summary: The candidate edit correctly addresses all four error targets. It removes the incorrect claims that the comment is grounded in specific parts of the paper and that it meets the criteria for a fully grounded comment. It correctly distinguishes between topical specificity and grounded part identification under the rubric. It preserves the valid observations about the comment specifying what needs to be addressed and providing specific examples (e.g., Edge sampling in [1]). It does not state a numeric score or gold label, instead describing the rubric level qualitatively. The rationale is coherent and can be inserted into the rescoring pipeline.
